title: Dapper, a Large-Scale Distributed Systems Tracing Infrastructure
whyItMatters: Describes Google's production tracing system and its goals of low overhead and transparency, and Uber's engineers say they built Dapper-style tracing into their RPC protocol.

claim.phrase: style distributed tracing built into the protocol as a first-class citizen

evidence: low overhead, application-level transparency, and ubiquitous deployment
